providers.name: GitHub
checklist: Create or verify the production GitHub OAuth app.
Install GITHUB_CLIENT_ID and GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET as Cloudflare Worker secrets.
Complete hosted sign-in through GitHub and verify the dashboard session resolves the signed-in user.
providers.notes: Disabled for alpha launch until the production GitHub OAuth app client id and secret are installed.

providers.name: Google
checklist: Create or verify the production Google OAuth client.
Install GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET as Cloudflare Worker secrets.
Complete hosted sign-in through Google and verify the dashboard session resolves the signed-in user.
providers.notes: Disabled for alpha launch until the production Google OAuth client id and secret are installed.
